NBA DFS Rankings for Saturday, October 24 (DraftKings)

DraftKings main slate · Saturday, October 24 · 5 games · First game 7:30 PM ET · By Chris Spags · · Numbers as of October 24, 8:21 PM ET

Victor Wembanyama (SAS) ranks first on the Saturday, October 24 DraftKings main slate at 57.9 projected DraftKings points for $10,700. Anthony Davis (WAS, 48.7) and Jalen Johnson (ATL, 46.6) are next.

The table ranks the top 100 of 142 players in the run by SPAGS projection, with DraftKings salary and projected points per $1,000.

Every projection is a SPAGS model estimate from the October 24, 8:21 PM ET run of the Splash Play NBA model. This page updates each time the main-slate numbers are run, and NBA projections move with every injury report, so check the time above before you build.
